stem: Which medication is first-line treatment for problematic infantile haemangiomas?
explanation: Propranolol is the first-line treatment for problematic infantile haemangiomas because it can rapidly reduce lesion size and has a better side-effect profile than older therapies.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because oral corticosteroids were used previously but are no longer first-line for problematic infantile haemangiomas due to adverse effects.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because propranolol, a beta-blocker, is the preferred first-line treatment for problematic infantile haemangiomas.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because topical retinoids are not standard treatment for infantile haemangiomas.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because intravenous chemotherapy is not used to treat benign infantile haemangiomas.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because topical timolol may be used for small superficial lesions, but propranolol is the first-line treatment for problematic infantile haemangiomas.

source.hint: This drug is a beta-blocker originally used for heart conditions.
